subject: note: The suicide experiences themselves bound as never before to the existence they rationally or irrationally wanted to leave behind. If suicide is an irrational leap, then why on earth should we rationally take it?
note: As paradoxical as it might sound, the decision to end one’s life is a requirement of life in order to escape a life of indignity and incarceration, the life of the concentration camp.
